nodes.author: NewsRxButter
nodes.text: Most HMPV infections are mild, resembling the common cold. But severe cases can result in bronchitis or pneumonia. Patients with pre-existing lung conditions, such as asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or emphysema, are at higher risk of severe outcomes. (2/4)

nodes.author: NewsRxButter
nodes.text:
In higher-income countries, the virus is rarely fatal; in lower-income countries, with weak health systems and poor surveillance, deaths are more common.
There is no vaccine against HMPV. But there is a vaccine for R.S.V., and research is underway to find a vaccination. (3/4)
